title: Get Parameter
text: Get ROS 2 parameter value, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of parameter; {Name} sets the parameter name, {Maximum length}, {Initial value} sets the default parameter value output and {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of parameter double (default) | int64 | boolean | uint8[] | double[] | int64[] | boolean[]

params.name: Maximum length
params.values: Maximum length of array 16 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Initial value
params.values: Default parameter value output 0.0 (default) | numeric scalar | vector
